text: {"name":"rf_consume_ring_entries","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Advances the 64-slot ring by the requested count, clears nonzero entries encountered and decrements the pending count, then returns the entry for the updated 12-bit index.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"result":"ring_state","a2":"advance_count","v2":"iteration_count","v3":"initial_cursor","v4":"pending_count","v5":"slot_index","v8":"updated_index"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":8,"meaning":"12-bit logical index, advanced by the requested count"},{"offset":10,"meaning":"6-bit cursor into the 64-slot ring"},{"offset":11,"meaning":"count of pending ring entries"},{"offset":16,"meaning":"base of the 64-entry array of 32-bit slot values"}]}
